# Lumenfield Networks -- Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement

This fictional Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement between Halvard Systems and Lumenfield Networks covers network monitoring and managed connectivity services and the commercial terms that apply to it. It is synthetic evaluation data, not legal advice and not a real agreement.

## Term and Renewal

This Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement has a fixed term that begins on 2025-05-19 and expires on 2026-05-19. It does not renew automatically. Halvard Systems and Lumenfield Networks may extend the term only by a written amendment executed at least forty-five (45) days before expiry.

## Termination

Halvard Systems may terminate this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement for convenience at any time on thirty (30) days written notice. Either party may terminate for cause where a material breach remains uncured thirty (30) days after notice, and Lumenfield Networks shall return or delete Customer materials on termination.

## Confidentiality

Confidential Information disclosed under this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement remains the property of the disclosing party. Lumenfield Networks shall return or destroy the Confidential Information of Halvard Systems on request, and confidentiality obligations survive five (5) years beyond termination.

## Governing Law

Governing law and venue. The law of the State of Delaware applies to this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement. Lumenfield Networks and Halvard Systems agree that the courts of the State of Delaware have exclusive jurisdiction over disputes arising from it.

## Notices

Notices under this Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement are effective when sent to contracts@halvard.example.com for Halvard Systems and to contracts@lumenfield.example.com for Lumenfield Networks, with delivery confirmed in writing. Either party may change its notice address by giving notice in the same way.

## Signatures

Signed for Halvard Systems by Marit Halvorsen, Director of Procurement. Signed for Lumenfield Networks by Dara Okonjo, VP Customer Accounts. All signatories named in this document are fictional and no real person is represented.
